verdict.rationale: Composio documents allowlisting at both levels the story asks for. Sessions, which by default can reach the whole catalog, can be restricted to specific toolkits via the `toolkits` parameter. MCP servers can be limited to an explicit `allowed_tools` list per toolkit, and the direct-tools preset serves exactly the listed tools over one MCP URL. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that these restrictions are enforced, and documentation of finer-grained policy (role- or per-user access rules, denylists, audit of blocked calls).
